title: a class verb the floor links reds when git holds it without the exec bit
intention: build_inspector's sieve class_verbs_are_executable reds a device component holding a file the floor links as a class verb (cairn/devices/<d>/0/bin/*, and cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py) whose git index mode is not 100755, naming the file and its mode.
why: Measured 2026-11-23 on akiendelllinux: 60de22e64, a build made on Windows, created cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py as 100644. The floor (bin/cairn.py _wire_instances) links it as the live superclaude verb, the dispatch refuses a file without the exec bit, and `cairn superclaude` answered 127 for ten hours with nothing red but two proofs in other components. The class: a script born on Windows lands as 100644, because Windows has no exec bit. Ticket 846b6ca0eaf7 fixes the one file and its proof measures only cc (outline 19.6); a check over every device is not inside cc's bounds, so it is this sieve.
traces_to: Law 4 (a rule that matters is physics: 'a class verb is executable' becomes a sieve, not a habit a Windows build forgets) and Law 9 (the red shows at the component that holds the file, on every inspect).
how: Add a record-phase sieve class_verbs_are_executable(row, comp_dir) to inspector.py, registered in SIEVES with its descriptor beside the others: for a device row it runs `git ls-files -s` over <device>/0/bin/* (and, for cc, superclaude.py), and returns one finding per entry whose mode is not 100755. A red-first proof builds a scratch git repo with one 100644 and one 100755 verb and calls the sieve.

clauses.claim: over a scratch repo whose device x holds x/0/bin/v at git mode 100644, class_verbs_are_executable on x's row returns a finding naming cairn/devices/x/0/bin/v and 100644
the same repo with v at 100755 returns no finding
cc's superclaude.py at 100644 in a scratch repo reds cc's row the same way
class_verbs_are_executable is registered in SIEVES and has its descriptor under sieves/

decisions.text: D1: inspector.py gains class_verbs_are_executable(row, comp_dir), record phase, registered in SIEVES. It reads the repo with _repo_of, lists `git ls-files -s` over cairn/devices/<d>/0/bin/* for a device row (plus cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py on cc's row, the set bin/cairn.py _wire_instances links), and returns one finding per entry not 100755 naming the path and the mode; a non-device row, or a repo git cannot read, returns [] only where the row holds no class verb, and a git failure is a finding, never silence (Law 7).
D2: its descriptor cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/sieves/class_verbs_are_executable.json, shaped as its neighbours in sieves/.

D3: the red-first proof cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_class_verbs_are_executable.py, PROVES edea73e1b281 keys 1-4, one tooth per clause, each over a scratch git repo made through the scratch door; it never reads the house's index.

constraints: the sieve only reads git's index; it never chmods or rewrites a mode
the proof builds its repos through the scratch door, never in the house

out: bin/cairn.py (what the floor links is read, not changed)
a pre-commit door refusing 100644 at write time

measured.saw: git log --summary: 60de22e64 'create mode 100644 cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py'; `cairn superclaude --dry-run` rc 127 from the house; of 28 files the floor links as class verbs, the only one not 100755
measured.how: git log --summary, git ls-files -s and a by-hand launch on akiendelllinux

measured.saw: outline check open-1bc45f01e084 on 846b6ca0eaf7: a ticket's proofs measure only its own component (outline 19.6, 9.4.2.3.7.1), so 846b's mode tooth reads only cc and the every-device check left its bounds
bin/cairn.py _wire_instances links cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py and every file under cairn/devices/*/0/bin
the orchestrator ruled the later sieve is cast now, not left as an IOU, its id named in 846b6ca0eaf7's bounds.out
